title: Deadlock
provenance: DXMT changelog v0.73 (github.com/3Shain/dxmt/releases). playX18 (highball-db#243, 2026-09-28): rated 4, playable with minor issues, Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0, DXMT, a full standard match played; engine and Highball version not stated. Hetens (highball-db#387, 2026-10-08): rated 4 after 19 minutes, Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, DXMT, "temperatures on the higher side but still very good". LucasMenezeslc (highball-db#507, 2026-10-15), Apple M4, macOS 26.3, Highball 0.10.15, engine r26, DXMT, 60 fps cap, rated 3 of 5 after 20 minutes and then 'working fine'. Not verified by the maintainer. josespite-gif (highball-db#705, 2026-10-26), Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, msync, rated 4 of 5 after 6 minutes, minor issues not described. NullyDev-9 (highball-db#726, 2026-10-27), Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, msync, Metal HUD on, rated 4 of 5 after 8 minutes, minor issues not described. mlohan8240 (highball-db#828, 2026-10-30), Apple M2 Max, macOS 15.6.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK with the environment in DXMT mode, rated 3 of 5 after 9 minutes, frames dropped when shooting. kungfukenny-k (highball-db#844, 2026-10-31), Apple M4, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 28 minutes, a Street Brawl match at 50 to 60 fps. loerinchajas (highball-db#891, 2026-11-01), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 57 minutes: frame drops when many players are on screen. mehmetsedatovur (highball-db#1118, 2026-11-09), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT by the report (the environment's mode is D3DMetal), rated 4 of 5 after 15 minutes: nothing stated about what wasn't perfect. OrestFulmes (highball-db#1159, 2026-11-11), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 153 minutes. zxcqirara (highball-db#1230, 2026-11-15), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 15.8.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r27, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 32 minutes: with the csgo-legacy and corefonts recipes in the environment, over the main menu and two Street Brawl matches, with freezes in heavy fights, and on the first launch even in the main menu. danielgul (highball-db#1257, 2026-11-15), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, DXMT by the report (the environment's mode is DXVK), rated 3 of 5 after 112 minutes: one crash to the desktop in 42 hours of play by the player's account, sound, networking and matchmaking fine. At 2560x1440 borderless on an external monitor, the lowest settings, FSR2 and a 60 fps cap in Highball and in game: noticeable input lag with vSync off, which fullscreen at 1920x1080 lessens but doesn't remove, a lower resolution in borderless windowed mode stays in a window instead of filling the screen, occasional random stutters, and drops to 30 to 40 fps in hectic fights. bingcheng45 (highball-db#1305, 2026-11-18), Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 56 minutes: 5 matches with no issues, apart from occasional lag from ping spikes and from shader rendering in the player's words. turbiv (highball-db#1377, 2026-11-21), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 43 minutes: with the Steam id given and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes.
notes: DXMT's changelog lists the MetalFX temporal scaler output as fixed. A report has a full standard match playable on DXMT on an M5 Pro, with two costs: about ten minutes of shader compilation before the game stops stuttering, and audio crackle, which that player fixed by setting the Mac's output to 88.2 kHz in Audio MIDI Setup. A second M5 Pro report (19 minutes on DXMT) says it runs very well and only runs warm. One report on D3DMetal too (M5, 4 of 5 after 8 minutes), so both modes start it. Rated perfect on an M5 Pro with DXMT on the default engine (r28) over 153 minutes (highball-db#1159). On an M4 Pro with macOS 15.8.2 and the Wine 11 engine r27 on DXMT, rated playable over 32 minutes with freezes in heavy fights, and on the first launch even in the main menu (highball-db#1230). An M3 Pro rated it playable with workarounds after 42 hours on the Wine 10 engine r29, with input lag, random stutters and drops to 30 to 40 fps in hectic fights at the lowest settings (highball-db#1257). An M1 Max rated it perfect over 56 minutes and 5 matches with DXMT on the default engine r28, with occasional lag from ping spikes and shader rendering (highball-db#1305). An M5 Pro rated it perfect over 43 minutes with DXMT on the default engine r28 (highball-db#1377).

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

knownIssues.symptom: Audio crackles (reported in the main hub on an M5 MacBook Air, highball#187, and in matches on an M5 Pro, highball-db#243).
knownIssues.cause: Most likely the same as Counter-Strike 2's, another Source 2 game: it keeps very little sound queued and at 48 kHz the Mac asked Wine for more at a time than it had (measured on Counter-Strike 2, highball#127). Not measured on Deadlock itself
knownIssues.fix: Highball 0.10.3 and later carry the fix that cured Counter-Strike 2's crackle (default engine r19 and later, Wine 11 engine r14 and later), not yet confirmed on Deadlock (highball#187). On older engines, setting the Mac's output to 88.2 kHz in Audio MIDI Setup worked for one player

knownIssues.symptom: Stutter for the first minutes of a match (reported on an M5 Pro, DXMT).
knownIssues.fix: none needed, it settles after about ten minutes.

knownIssues.symptom: Noticeable input lag with vSync off, in borderless and in fullscreen (M3 Pro, Wine 10 r29, DXMT, highball-db#1257)
knownIssues.fix: lowering the resolution to 1920x1080 in fullscreen helped the reporter but didn't remove it

knownIssues.symptom: In borderless windowed mode, a resolution below the display's own stays in a window instead of filling the screen (M3 Pro, Wine 10 r29, DXMT, highball-db#1257)
